summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed before print_exception, next to print). It joins str(obj) values with sep and delegates once to self.print with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False; highlight defaults to True. Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging, a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added bullet "Added Console.out", and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_* aspect tests, with RenderHook and Text imports at the top). Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. No commits made.
